name: teleporters
description: Production `teleporter` markers registered exactly as sgp.world:initialization does, so minecraft:execute_repeating_functions drives the real per-tick teleporter loop (particles, countdown, arrival). `markers` scales the registry (macro-cache knee); `standing` actors stand on pads whose destination is the pad itself, so they cycle through the 3-second countdown and arrival forever; the other pads contain nobody, like most of a real map's teleporters at any instant.
